title: Scarab of Protection
summary: Unobtainable amulet grants Advantage on saves against spells and a necromancy save reaction.

fields.Necromantic Evasion: When you fail a save against a necromancy spell or a spell cast by an undead foe, spend a Reaction to succeed. The source lists a Short Rest recharge in the action data while its tooltip says Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 320 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
